# Monarch

> Open-source design system for everyone who builds: startups, enterprise teams, independent designers and developers. Design tokens; light, dark and high-contrast themes; accessible brand palettes from one colour (deriveTheme); server-render safe React components including charts, data tables, scheduling, collaboration, an editor and marketing blocks; and a conformance CLI. Released under the Apache License 2.0. Made by Rook.

The canonical llms.txt is published with the docs site: https://monarchui.dev/llms.txt. It lists every page as Markdown. This file is its short form for the source repository.

## Docs (canonical)

- [llms.txt](https://monarchui.dev/llms.txt): every docs page, with a link to its Markdown copy
- [llms-full.txt](https://monarchui.dev/llms-full.txt): the whole site in one file
- Per package entry: [core](https://monarchui.dev/llms/core.txt), [ai](https://monarchui.dev/llms/ai.txt), [charts](https://monarchui.dev/llms/charts.txt), [data](https://monarchui.dev/llms/data.txt), [patterns](https://monarchui.dev/llms/patterns.txt), [shell](https://monarchui.dev/llms/shell.txt), [scheduling](https://monarchui.dev/llms/scheduling.txt), [collaboration](https://monarchui.dev/llms/collaboration.txt), [editor](https://monarchui.dev/llms/editor.txt), [marketing](https://monarchui.dev/llms/marketing.txt), [rook](https://monarchui.dev/llms/rook.txt), [guides](https://monarchui.dev/llms/guides.txt)
- [Getting started](https://monarchui.dev/getting-started/index.md)

## Machine-readable files in the packages

- Component manifest: `@rookcom/monarch-react/manifest.json` (every export with props, defaults, allowed values, import line, stylesheets, docs URL and `scope`; [JSON Schema](https://monarchui.dev/schema/manifest.json))
- Tokens: `@rookcom/monarch-tokens/tokens.json`, W3C DTCG `@rookcom/monarch-tokens/tokens.dtcg.json` with `tokens.resolver.json`, Figma variables `@rookcom/monarch-tokens/figma-variables.json`
- Contrast decisions per product: `@rookcom/monarch-tokens/contrast-report.json`
- Conformance CLI: `npx monarch check`, `monarch search`, `monarch add`, and an MCP server (`monarch mcp`) from `@rookcom/monarch-conformance`
- ESLint plugin (flat config): `@rookcom/monarch-conformance/eslint`, with `configs.recommended` and `configs.general`
- Starters: `npx @rookcom/monarch-conformance create <dir> --template next-app|vite-react` (sources in templates/starters/)
- Rook-specific exports: `@rookcom/monarch-react/rook`
- Bundle-size budgets per entry and component: registry/size-budgets.json

## In this repository

- Start here: README.md, AGENTS.md
- Guides: docs/guides/ (getting-started, theming, frameworks, conformance, migration, component-contract)
- Governance: docs/governance/ (versioning, deprecation, accessibility statement, accessibility conformance report, performance budgets, browser support, dependencies)
- Component registry (generated): registry/components.json
- Decisions: docs/adr/
- License: Apache-2.0 (LICENSE, NOTICE). All components, tokens and themes are free to use; the Rook and Monarch names and logos are trademarks (TRADEMARK.md).
